text.arabic_uthmani: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ

words.gloss_range: the possessed endpoint or seal-mark of the already mentioned drink, locally evaluated by the following musk predicate
words.root_gloss_range: completion, sealing, stamping, securing, and final trace; here the endpoint and seal-mark branches are active while remote idioms and object branches remain background

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nominative predicate naming the seal's musk quality

words.prose: {{ar:خِتَٰمُهُۥ}} ({{tr:khitāmuhu}}) starts the ayah from the drink's end, not from a new drink-name. The suffix carries the sealed drink from 83:25 into a nominal subject, so the listener waits for what this possessed finish amounts to. The root {{ar:خ ت م}} ({{tr:kh-t-m}}) lets completion and seal-mark work together: the endpoint is also an authenticated trace, and {{ar:مِسْكٌۭ}} ({{tr:miskun}}) will name that trace as fragrance. Variant pressures toward a signet or finishing marker can be noted, but the local grammar keeps the canonical word as the drink's possessed endpoint before the predicate resolves its value.

topics.headline: the drink's finish becomes the subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah does not restart with a generic seal; it makes the already sealed drink's own finish the grammatical topic.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:خِتَٰمُهُۥ}} ({{tr:khitāmuhu}}) as a nominative verbal noun with a third masculine singular suffix referring back to the sealed drink; the predicate follows in the same nominal clause.

topics.headline: completion becomes a fragrant seal-mark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that closure is not mere ending; it is a final trace that authenticates the reward through scent.
topics.reason: V4 supports final-end and seal-mark branches for {{ar:خ ت م}} ({{tr:kh-t-m}}), while the local predicate {{ar:مِسْكٌۭ}} ({{tr:miskun}}) narrows the active payoff to a completed endpoint that is read by its fragrant mark.

topics.headline: variant forms keep signet and finisher in view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear why the word attracts seal-object and finishing-marker associations without letting those alternatives replace the local endpoint reading.
topics.reason: The variant rows are useful apparatus for signet and agentive-finisher pressure, but QAC gives the local surface as a gerundal possessed subject, so the variants qualify rather than govern the parse.

topics.headline: the prior sealed drink returns as endpoint disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two-ayah handoff: what was sealed in 83:25 becomes disclosed by its finish in 83:26.
topics.reason: The suffix points back to the drink in 83:25, and the CRITICAL inter-ayah rows explicitly tie the prior sealed description to the present endpoint noun.

topics.headline: the word's sound carries closure into the suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closure-word as a compact transition from seal-like onset into the suffix that carries the hidden drink.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows are not independent semantics, but they preserve a local audible payoff already anchored by suffix grammar and variant surface pressure.

words.gloss_range: musk as an indefinite qualitative predicate: the seal's scent-kind and value-sign, not an object being acted on
words.root_gloss_range: holding, retaining, clinging, and musk perfume; here the perfume branch is selected while retention imagery colors the scent's persistence
words.prose: {{ar:مِسْكٌۭ}} ({{tr:miskun}}) is the predicate that resolves the first clause: the drink's ending is musk in quality. Its indefiniteness makes the scent qualitative rather than measured, and its concrete perfume sense turns completion into something perceptible. The broader {{ar:م س ك}} ({{tr:m-s-k}}) field of holding and clinging should not replace the perfume noun, but it sharpens the payoff: the fragrance feels retained at the endpoint as the seal's evidentiary sign. The rare aromatic diction also joins reward scenes where named scents carry bliss concretely, as in 76:5 and 76:17, while here the scent is specifically the seal's finish. As the adjacent predicate, its m-sound also answers the closure-word and helps the value statement land before the rivalry command begins.

topics.headline: musk predicates the seal's quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that musk is not an added ornament; it is the predicate that tells what the seal itself is like.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make {{ar:مِسْكٌۭ}} ({{tr:miskun}}) the nominative predicate of {{ar:خِتَٰمُهُۥ}} ({{tr:khitāmuhu}}); the tanwīn supports qualitative rather than counted force.

topics.headline: concrete perfume makes completion perceptible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reward value is carried by a sensory sign: the endpoint is experienced as prized fragrance.
topics.reason: V4 includes a musk-perfume branch for {{ar:م س ك}} ({{tr:m-s-k}}), and QAC marks the local word as a concrete noun functioning as the predicate of the closure.

topics.headline: holding imagery colors the lasting scent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel why the scent is not fleeting: the root's holding field colors musk as a fragrance retained at the finish.
topics.reason: The local noun selects the perfume branch, so holding and clinging derivatives may color persistence but must not turn {{ar:مِسْكٌۭ}} ({{tr:miskun}}) into a verbal act or agent.

topics.headline: rare aromatic reward diction becomes local seal-scent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that bliss is being named through rare scent language, while this ayah localizes the aroma as the drink's seal.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows explicitly compare rare aromatic reward diction in 76:5 and 76:17, but the local syntax narrows the echo to scent as the predicate of the seal.

topics.headline: scented value prepares rivalry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the scent-word establishes value before the command to compete arrives.
topics.reason: External cooccurrence is weak, but attachment evidence strongly links the musk-seal clause to the following exhortation, so the local sequence carries the payoff.

topics.headline: the m-sound binds closure to perfume
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the predicate as an audible answer to the closure-word, with the shared m-sound helping the first beat land.
topics.reason: The sound rows are locally anchored by the adjacent subject-predicate construction and do not introduce a separate lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector linking the completed musk-seal statement to the following exhortative domain phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: connector plus prepositional demonstrative phrase opening the exhortative domain

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the musk-seal clause from closing as decorative description. After the nominal statement is complete, the connector resumes into the phrase {{ar:وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:wa-fī dhālika}}), joining the scent-value to the domain that will govern competition. Its attachment to the following preposition makes the turn from description to exhortation immediate in both grammar and sound, so the reader hears the domain phrase arrive as a joined onset rather than a detached new start.

topics.headline: description stays linked to exhortation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the musk statement becomes a premise for response, not an isolated sensory detail.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a conjunction, and attachment evidence links the prior nominal clause to a result/exhortation sequence.

topics.headline: the connector fuses into the domain marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition as a joined onset, with the connector moving directly into the domain phrase.
topics.reason: The bundle segments {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) and {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) separately but the surface sequence remains a fused transition into the governed phrase.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the demonstrative and fronting the field or concern-domain in which rivalry is to be directed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: demonstrative governed by the preposition as the competition domain
jussive Form VI verb whose rivalry is framed by the prepositional domain

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) places the coming competition inside a defined value-field before the verb arrives, and its surface bond with the preceding connector makes that field arrive as part of the same turn out of the musk clause. It governs {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}), so the phrase is not a loose location but the domain or concern around which the command is framed. The physical sense of being in something remains imagistically useful, but the local attachment to {{ar:يَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:yatanāfasi}}) selects an abstract field of rivalry: compete with regard to that reward, not in rivalry as such.

topics.headline: the preposition fixes rivalry's field first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that competition is constrained before it is commanded; rivalry is aimed at that value-field.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) the complement governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), and the prepositional phrase frames the domain for {{ar:يَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:yatanāfasi}}).

topics.headline: physical in becomes concern-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the arena-like image while reading the local force as concern or orientation rather than literal containment.
topics.reason: The preposition can carry spatial imagery, but the verb frame and translation support identify its local role as a semantic domain or object-field for competition.

topics.headline: the domain marker is bound to the connective turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the field of rivalry arrive as part of the same transition out of the musk clause.
topics.reason: The surface sequence binds the conjunction and preposition, while word order places the domain phrase before the command verb.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative governed by the preposition, pointing back to the musk-marked reward field with deliberately controlled breadth
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) gathers the reward just evoked and makes it the field of rivalry. As the governed complement of {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), it is not a new subject; it is the target-domain before the command. Its distal form singles the reward out with valued distance, and its scope should not be over-fixed: it can point narrowly to the musk-sealed drink or broadly to the whole reward scene. That breadth is useful because the command responds both to a sensory endpoint and to the larger value-field.

topics.headline: the demonstrative is the governed target-field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the command has a definite target-domain, not an unspecified prize or a new independent topic.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a demonstrative pronoun in genitive after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), and attachment evidence warns against narrowing the referent to only one possible antecedent.

topics.headline: narrow scent and broad reward stay live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demonstrative can carry both the musk-marked endpoint and the larger reward scene into the command.
topics.reason: The bundle explicitly marks the demonstrative reference as ambiguous and instructs preservation of that ambiguity, so the broad and narrow readings are retained together.

topics.headline: distance marks the reward as singled out
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the target as a known, elevated object of aspiration rather than a merely nearby referent.
topics.reason: The distal demonstrative is locally governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), so its deictic force is read as value-marking within the competition domain.

topics.headline: the pointer lingers before the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the target of desire before the act of striving is named.
topics.reason: The written/recited shape and fronted phrase place {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) before {{ar:يَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:yatanāfasi}}), so the target is established first.

words.gloss_range: resultive conjunction that turns the named value-field into the premise for the command

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: surface chain containing the command lām and the jussive competition verb

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge where sensory valuation becomes demanded response. It does more than continue the sentence: before the command lām and the verb, it makes competition follow as consequence from the reward just described. The surface chain {{ar:فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:fal-yatanāfasi}}) therefore compresses result, command, and act into one launch.

topics.headline: the command follows because value has been shown
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that rivalry is not detached advice; it is the consequence of recognizing the reward's value.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) as a conjunction, and attachment evidence describes the following clause as a result linked to the preceding reward description.

topics.headline: result and command arrive in one chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah pivot quickly from value statement to action without a separate explanatory sentence.
topics.reason: The surface sequence combines {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), command lām, and the jussive verb, while the attachment evidence preserves the command force.

words.gloss_range: command lām attached to the imperfect, giving the following verb jussive exhortative force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: surface chain containing the command lām and the jussive competition verb

words.prose: {{ar:لْ}} ({{tr:l}}) converts the following imperfect into a directive: this is not a report that competitors compete, but an exhortation that they should. Because it follows the result particle and the fronted value-field, the command sounds normative and invitational at once: if anything is worth rivalry, let it be that. Its clipped, bound form makes the command force an attachment inside {{ar:فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:fal-yatanāfasi}}), not a separate verb of ordering.

topics.headline: the particle makes the verb an exhortation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah directs rivalry rather than merely describing it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:لْ}} ({{tr:l}}) as the command particle governing {{ar:يَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:yatanāfasi}}) and warns not to flatten the construction into an indicative statement.

topics.headline: command becomes a ranking of desire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command as a re-ranking of what deserves human competitive energy.
topics.reason: The command particle follows a resultive {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) and a fronted {{ar:فِى ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:fī dhālika}}) domain, so its force is exhortative and value-ranking.

topics.headline: the clipped particle launches the long verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears command force packed into a brief bound onset before the extended striving verb.
topics.reason: The particle is segmented but bound to the following imperfect; the phonetic rows preserve the local effect of a short command hinge launching the verb.

words.gloss_range: Form VI jussive exhortation to compete, vie, or aspire mutually within the fronted value-field
words.root_gloss_range: breath, self, relief, preciousness, inner self, and rivalry for valued things; here the preciousness/rivalry branch is selected with self/breath pressure coloring the striving

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fronted prepositional phrase naming the value-field of competition

words.prose: {{ar:يَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:yatanāfasi}}) is where the ayah turns valuation into action. The command lām makes the imperfect jussive, while the third-person form and postverbal plural subject make the exhortation class-directed rather than a direct second-person address. Form VI preserves mutual rivalry: the ayah does not merely say to seek the reward, but redirects competitive social energy into the value-field named by {{ar:فِى ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:fī dhālika}}). The root {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) brings self, breath, and preciousness into the verb, so aspiration is pictured as selves spending vitality toward what is truly valuable. The command also stands near Quranic racing-to-good formulas (2:148; 5:48), but this ayah specializes that pattern by grounding the rivalry in the musk-marked reward scene and by immediately echoing the verb-root in the actor noun that follows, so the commanded act is heard already leaning into an actor identity.

topics.headline: the verb directs a class rather than reporting action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause is an exhortation addressed through a general class form, not a statement about existing competitors.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the verb as a Form VI imperfect jussive active verb, and attachment evidence ties it to the command particle and the following plural subject.

topics.headline: competition arrives already constrained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that rivalry is not open-ended; it is aimed into the already named reward field.
topics.reason: The verb has no direct object in the attachment frame and is constrained by the preposed {{ar:فِى ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:fī dhālika}}) prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: Form VI preserves social rivalry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rivalry itself is disciplined and redirected, not erased into solitary desire or simple seeking.
topics.reason: The local form is Form VI and the frame is intransitive with a prepositional domain, supporting reciprocal/value-directed vying rather than a simple transitive request.

topics.headline: self and breath color value-directed striving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the command as personal expenditure of self and vitality toward what is precious.
topics.reason: V4 gives many {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) branches, but the local Form VI competition frame selects preciousness/rivalry while self and breath remain coloring pressures.

topics.headline: reward description becomes commanded response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah's movement from sensory evaluation to human response.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence links the nominal musk-seal clause to the result command, and the verb is the first lexical action of that command.

topics.headline: racing formulas are specialized by the reward scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a wider Quranic pattern of directed striving (2:148; 5:48), while seeing this ayah specify the prize-field through fragrance and reward.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah CRITICAL rows explicitly cite 2:148 and 5:48; the local wording narrows that echo by using {{ar:يَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:yatanāfasi}}) after the musk-seal value statement.

topics.headline: verb and actor noun share the n-f-s beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the commanded act already leaning into the actor identity named by the next word.
topics.reason: The following subject repeats the same root, and attachment evidence identifies it as the postverbal subject of {{ar:يَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:yatanāfasi}}).

words.gloss_range: definite masculine sound plural active participle naming the competitors or aspirants as the postverbal subject and final actor-class
words.root_gloss_range: breath, self, preciousness, rivalry, inner identity, and value-seeking; here the active participle selects value-directed competitive agents
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ}} ({{tr:al-mutanāfisūna}}) closes the ayah by naming the people who should enact the command. The singular verb has already launched the act, and this definite sound plural resolves the subject as a recognizable class. Because it is an active participle from the same {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) root, the word turns commanded rivalry into agentive identity: these are competitors or aspirants defined by what they judge precious. The common self-root is sharpened into a personal, embodied competitor label, so the class is made of selves spending vitality toward the musk-marked reward rather than rivals over any prize whatsoever. The final position matters; the ayah does not end on the reward object but on the class whose social rivalry has been redirected toward it, and the extended same-root closing sound completes the command beat.

topics.headline: the final noun names the summoned class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command resolve into a human class rather than remaining an abstract act.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a definite masculine sound plural active participle, and attachment evidence makes it the postverbal subject of {{ar:يَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:yatanāfasi}}).

topics.headline: definiteness and plurality make a recognizable actor class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names a class of proper aspirants, not a single rival or random competitors.
topics.reason: The definite article and sound plural ending distribute the identity across a class while preserving its subject role after the verb.

topics.headline: the participle makes rivalry an identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that true competitors are defined by value-recognition, not by intensity of contest alone.
topics.reason: The active participle is the nominal counterpart to the Form VI command and locally selects the preciousness/rivalry branch of {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}).

topics.headline: self and breath color the competitor class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the actor identity as personal and embodied: selves expend vitality toward the valued reward.
topics.reason: The broad {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) family includes self and breath branches, but the local active participle and fronted value-field narrow the sense to value-directed competitors.

topics.headline: a rare agent label concentrates the root at closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a common self-root sharpened into a marked competitor identity at the ayah's end.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks this exact form as low occurrence, while the CRITICAL rows contrast the agent label with the root's broader self-noun distribution.

topics.headline: the ayah ends on redirected actors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward scene resolve into the people whose rivalry should be redirected toward it.
topics.reason: The word is the final word of the ayah and the explicit subject that completes the verbal clause.

topics.headline: the actor noun completes the verb-root echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the commanded act and the named actors as one root-linked exhortation.
topics.reason: The subject repeats the same root as {{ar:يَتَنَافَسِ}} ({{tr:yatanāfasi}}), and the contextual collocation summary records that local verb-agent pairing.

topics.headline: the competitor class is defined by the scented value-field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that these competitors are aspirants toward the musk-marked reward, not competitors over any prize whatsoever.
topics.reason: The external root-pair evidence is weak, but the local ayah places the musk predicate before the fronted domain and competitor subject, so the value-field defines the actor class.

topics.headline: the closing class-name stretches the sound of striving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final noun as the audible completion of the command beat.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows are anchored by the final position and same-root relation to the preceding verb.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The endpoint discloses the drink's value.** `خ ت م` B001 supplies reaching the final end, and `ن ف س` B010 supplies precious value desired by selves and rivalry for it. The sequence moves from the sealed condition in 83:25 to the drink's ending, then explicitly redirects competition toward `ذَٰلِكَ`. I assign the endpoint the role of final disclosure and rivalry the role of desire reoriented toward a good whose finish confirms its quality. The abductive arrow is that a trustworthy end validates the whole course. The ayah reads as competition governed by disclosed excellence rather than hidden shorting.

2. **A remainder that holds after completion.** `م س ك` B003 supplies a remnant of good, drink, or strength that sustains, while the surface `مِسْك` provides the aromatic item named in the ayah. In proximity to `خِتَامُهُ`, I infer that value remains perceptible after consumption rather than vanishing at acquisition. This latent holding-image changes the finish from a terminal boundary into a durable sensory remainder.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The elevated mixture and spring in 83:27–28 clarified what worthy competition reaches toward: not possession detached from others, but proximity to a replenishing source.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A preserved finish, not a dissipating luxury.** Lexical evidence: خ ت م/B001, "reaching the final end and completing," in خِتَٰمُهُۥ, and م س ك/B001, "holding and restraining a thing," activated in مِسْكٌۭ. Structural cue: the preceding drink is sealed (83:25), while its mixture and spring are disclosed at 83:27-28. Assigned role: the finish completes the draught; the musk-root's holding image preserves quality at that endpoint. Abductive move: I infer material preservation from the root convergence of seal and holding; مِسْك explicitly names musk, not the act of restraint. Reading change: the fragrance reads as the sensory proof that completion has not degraded the gift.

2. **Competition is redirected toward what selves truly prize.** Lexical evidence: ن ف س/B010, "precious value desired by selves," in both يَتَنَافَسِ and ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ. Structural cue: marked record, witness, radiance, and pure provision establish the valued object at 83:21-25; 83:29-31 then shows a rival social economy of laughter, winks, and boastful enjoyment. Assigned role: B010 identifies rivalry as a detector of what the self regards as precious. Abductive move: I infer that the imperative recalibrates desire away from reputational dominance toward authenticated good. Reading change: competition is not rejected; its object is corrected, making rivalry an ethical disclosure of value.

3. **Resolve replaces self-exultation.** Lexical evidence: ن ف س/B014, "self-regard, resolve, and noble character," activated in the reciprocal forms. Structural cue: the command to compete is followed by criminals laughing, signaling, and returning home فَكِهِينَ (83:29-31; ف ك ه/B006, insolent exultance). Assigned role: B014 supplies disciplined inner mettle; the later group supplies distorted self-regard fed by another's humiliation. Abductive move: I infer that both are rival formations of the self because the sequence contrasts their desired rewards. Reading change: فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ calls for a durable reconstitution of resolve, not a burst of acquisitive envy.

4. **Breath links fragrance, drink, and striving.** Lexical evidence: ن ف س/B001, "breath leaving the body," secondarily activated in the doubled root, beside musk and the drink sequence. Structural cue: fragrance is apprehended through breath, and the packet places this breath-root imperative at the sensory endpoint of drinking. Assigned role: breath makes the prized good inwardly received while competition sends agents outward toward it. Abductive move: I infer an inhalation image from musk plus the breath branch; this is exploratory because the reciprocal form directly denotes rivalry. Reading change: striving is momentarily grounded in respiration: the desired order is something to take into the living self, not merely possess externally.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 83:29-31 supplied the retrospective control case for competition: laughter, covert signaling, and boastful home enjoyment reveal a rival economy of self-regard. This confirmed ن ف س/B010/B014 as the ayah's core change in reading, while the breath-fragrance activation remains secondary and exploratory.

baseline.text: Onun mührü misktir; öyleyse yarışanlar bunun için yarışsın.

findings.text: Miskin tutma çağrışımı, içeceğin sona vardığında niteliğini kaybetmediğini ve kokunun korunmuş tamamlanışın duyusal kanıtı olduğunu düşündürür.
İçim bittikten sonra kalan koku, iyiliğin tüketimle yok olmayan ve sonrasında da süren bir kalıntısıdır.
Yarışma reddedilmez; kişinin gerçekten değerli saydığı şeyi açığa çıkaran istek, doğrulanmış iyiliğe yöneltilir.
Buyruk, başkasını küçük düşürerek beslenen kendini beğenmenin karşısına kalıcı irade ve değerli karakter için çabayı koyar.
Misk ile nefes kökü arasındaki çağrışım, çabayı kokunun solukla içe alınması gibi yaşayan benliğe nüfuz eden bir yöneliş olarak düşündürebilir; ancak bu mekanizma biçimde açık değildir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Goods, values, and obligations are made commensurable so that transfer can be completed without hidden shortfall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Physical measure opens into market demand, pricing, debt, cash, surety, and delegated equivalence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Precious Good, Competition, and Hoarding
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A scarce valued object attracts competing claimants, rises in demand, and may be withheld rather than circulated.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: precious object competed for `ن ف س:B010/m01`; market demand `ق و م:B018/m01`; hoarding wealth `م س ك:B002/m01`; earning or acquisition `ك س ب:B001/m01`; present cash `ع ي ن:B011/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Preciousness generates desire, competition intensifies demand, acquisition transfers control, and hoarding interrupts recirculation of the valued resource.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Temporal Course, Occurrence, and Terminal Change
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Events occupy a bounded course with a beginning, recurrence, delay, approach, and completed outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ordinary duration expands into respite, cyclical passage, catastrophic occurrence, and resurrection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Waiting, Respite, and Imminence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A claimant waits, an interval opens, and the awaited event moves from deferment into nearness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: waiting and delay `ء ي ي:B001/m01`; granting respite `ن ظ ر:B002/m01`; breadth of time and interval `ن ف س:B015/m01`; approaching expiration `ق ر ب:B002/m01`; detained delay `ء ل ي:B013/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Respite is a structured interval between demand and event. Waiting occupies the interval, nearness contracts it, and expiration ends the possibility of further deferment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Linguistic operators locate a referent, join it to another term, open or correct discourse, and bind speakers to propositions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Function words form scenes of pointing, questioning, oath-taking, correction, essence-definition, and even letter and rhyme construction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Definition, Essence, and Signification
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A thing is isolated as itself, assigned a limit or definition, and allowed to signify its condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: essence or selfsame identity `ن ف س:B012/m01`; the thing itself `ع ي ن:B013/m01`; defining limit `ق و ل:B016/m01`; a thing's indicative “saying” `ق و ل:B014/m01`; locus where a quality is expected `ظ ن ن:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Identity supplies the referent, definition gives it a boundary, and signification lets its state communicate beyond explicit speech. The locus motif grounds abstract definition in where a property is expected to reside.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: People become socially located through family relation, marriage, shared habitation, hospitality, fellowship, and rank.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Household belonging reaches into collateral kin, step-relations, courtship, greeting, benefaction, and privileged intimacy.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Family Line and Collateral Relation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person belongs to a household through descent, return, collateral relation, and enduring social attachment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: household affiliation `ء ه ل:B001/m01`; family line and dependents `ء و ل:B003/m01`; blood kinship `ق ر ب:B003/m01`; collateral kin `ك ل ل:B004/m01`; social tie that holds people together `م س ك:B009/m02`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Descent supplies the close line, collateral kin extends it laterally, and the holding tie makes family a durable social relation rather than a list of names.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Visual knowledge reaches into eye anatomy, reflected human images, dream, apparition, harmful gaze, espionage, divination, and omen-bearing birds.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Harmful Gaze and Bodily Impact
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A gaze is believed to strike another person, leaving a visible defect or inward injury.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: injurious evil eye `ع ي ن:B004/m01`; harmful force issuing from a person `ن ف س:B003/m01`; injury reaching the heart `ق ل ب:B016/m01`; discoloring defect left by a look `ن ظ ر:B007/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The gaze functions as an agent, the person supplies its force, and the victim's body or color records the effect. Perception thus reverses into causation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Bracelet, Crown, and Pure Metal

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sona ulaşma ve son olma anlamlarını kapsar; mühür basma eylemini ya da mühürle engellemeyi kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel sona ulaşma çekirdeğini korurken iş, okuma, içecek, vadi ve son peygamber gibi yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleri ayrı uzmanlaşmalar olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin son sınırına ulaşmak ve böylece onu tamamlamak; ayrıca bu tamamlanmanın vardığı son bölüm, son kişi veya en uç nokta olmak.

Irmak ya da dalga için kullanıldığında suyun artıp dışarı doğru yayılmasını bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi değerli şeyi, ona yönelen isteği, uğrunda yarışmayı ve başkasına geçmesini istemeyerek esirgeme ya da kıskanmayı tek bir değer-yönelim zincirinde açıkça birleştirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Biçimler değerli şeyi ve yarışmayı, kalıplar ise o şeyi başkasından esirgeme veya kıskanmayı anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النفيس والنفاسة والمنفس، والرغبة والمنافسة في الشيء، والضن أو الحسد به إذا كان لقيمته ورغبة النفس فيه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو عزة النفس والهمة في صاحبها إلا إذا كان الكلام عن المال أو الشيء المرغوب فيه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: شيء نفيس ذو نفس وخطر يتنافس به والتنافس يبرز كل واحد قوة نفسه (maqayis); شيء نفيس متنافس فيه ونفست به ضننت (ayn); نافست في الشيء إذا رغبت فيه وتنافسوا فيه ونفس به أي ضن أو حسد (sihah); مال نفيس ومنفس وكل شيء له خطر وقدر ونفس عليك أي حسدك (tahdhib); المنافسة مجاهدة النفس للتشبه بالأفاضل ونفست بكذا ضنت نفسي به وشيء نفيس (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bedeni canlı tutan ilkeyi, onun bedenden çıkmasıyla ölümü ve her insanın canlı bir birey olarak bu adla sayılabilmesini doğrudan açıklar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bedensel yaşamı sağlayan can ve canlı bireydir; düşünce, özdeşlik vurgusu, kan ya da soluk değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, bedene yaşam veren canı ve bununla canlı sayılan bireyi kapsar; kalıp anlamı içe aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bedeni canlı tutan ve ayrılmasıyla ölümün gerçekleştiği candır. Bu yaşam taşıyıcısı bakımından her insan ayrı bir canlı birey olarak da sayılabilir.

facets.statement: Bedene yaşam veren ve bedenden ayrılması ölüm sayılan candır.
Bu canı taşıyan her insan ayrı bir canlı birey olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bedensel yaşamı sağlayan can, bu canın çıkmasıyla ölüm ve insanın canlı birey olarak sayılması üzerinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Canlılığı sağlayan ve bedenden ayrılması ölüm anlamına gelen yaşam taşıyıcısı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bedeni, yaşam verme işlevini ve ayrılınca ölüm sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların tek tek canlı varlıklar olarak sayıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her insanın ayrı bir canlı birey olarak sayılmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bedeni canlı tutan canı ve onun bedenden çıkmasını aynı sınırlarla anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Verilen kartlarda çekirdek, yaşam işlevi ve bedenden ayrılma sınırı bütünüyle örtüşür; anlamlı bir ayrım yoktur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar gözden geçirildi; yalnızca yaşam veren can anlamında tam sınır eşleşmesi gösteren eş anlamlı komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى الروح والحياة، وكل إنسان نفس، وخروج النفس عند الموت، والنفس الحية التي بها حياة الجسد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو ذات الشيء للتوكيد ولا ما في النفس من قصد أو غيب فقط.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النفس الروح الذي به حياة الجسد وكل إنسان نفس (ayn); النفس الروح يقال خرجت نفسه (sihah); خرجت نفس فلان أي روحه ونفس الحياة هي الروح (tahdhib); النفس الروح في قوله أخرجوا أنفسكم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin aynısını, bütün varlığını, gerçeğini ve özünü vurgulayan kullanımı açıkça verir. Kişinin aracısız olarak bizzat bulunması da aynı özdeşlik kalıbına bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca özdeşlik ve pekiştirme kalıplarındadır; canlılık ilkesi, zararlı bakış ya da iç düşünce değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, bir şeyin kendisini ya da bir kişinin bizzat bulunmasını bildiren kalıplarla sınırlıdır; çıplak anlama genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başkası ya da bir parçası değil, bütün gerçeği ve öz varlığıyla kendisi olduğunu vurgulamaktır. Kişi için kullanıldığında onun aracısız biçimde bizzat bulunmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin bütün gerçeği ve öz varlığıyla kendisini pekiştirerek gösterir.
Kişinin başkası aracılığıyla değil, bizzat kendisinin bulunmasını belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, şeyin kendisini bütün gerçeği ve özüyle vurgulama ile kişinin bizzat bulunması kullanımında birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: şeyin kendisi ve bütün öz varlığı
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesne ya da kişinin başkası değil tam olarak kendisi olduğu vurgulandığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Özdeşliği, bütünlüğü, gerçekliği ve pekiştirme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin aracı kullanmadan doğrudan bulunduğu ya da eylemi yaptığı bağlamda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin doğrudan ve aracısız bulunması vurgusunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bütün öz varlığı ve bizzat bulunmayı pekiştiren kalıpları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir öğeyi topluluğun geri kalanından özellikle seçip belirtme kullanımını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin başka bir şey değil, tam olarak kendisi olduğunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalıba bağlı özdeşlik pekiştirmesidir; komşu dal özdeşliğe ek olarak bir öğeyi topluluktan ayırıp belirleme işlevi taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar karşılaştırıldı; özdeşlik ortaklığını ve pekiştirme-seçip belirleme farkını gösteren komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى عين الشيء، ذاته، حقيقته، جملته، كنهه وجوهره، واستعمالها للتوكيد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الروح الحية ولا العين المؤذية ولا المعنى الباطن من القصد إلا بقرينة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: كل شيء بعينه نفس (ayn); نفس الشيء عينه يؤكد به (sihah); معنى النفس حقيقة الشيء وجملته وذاته كلها وعين الشيء وكنهه وجوهره (tahdhib); نفسه ذاته (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin içinde taşıdığı düşünceyi, niyeti ve bilgiyi; ayrıca ayırt etmeyi sağlayan zihinsel yetiyi açıkça aynı içsel idrak alanında toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal iç düşünce ve ayırt etme gücüyle sınırlıdır; kişinin bütünü, bedensel canı veya yalnızca dışa vurulmuş söz değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kalıp kullanım içteki düşünce ve niyeti, ayrı birim ise ayırt etmeyi sağlayan zihinsel gücü anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin içinde bulunan, henüz dışa vurulmamış düşünce, niyet veya bilgidir. Aynı alan, kişinin ayırt etmesini sağlayan zihinsel gücü de kapsar.

facets.statement: Kişinin içinde tuttuğu düşünce, niyet ya da kendine özgü bilgidir.
Doğru ayrımlar yapmayı sağlayan zihinsel yeti de bu içsel idrak alanında adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin içindeki düşünce ve bilgiyi ayırt etme yetisiyle birlikte içsel idrak alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: iç düşünce, niyet ve ayırt etme gücü
concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin dışa vurmadığı içeriği veya ayrım yapmasını sağlayan zihinsel yetisi anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İç düşünceyi, niyeti, bilgiyi ve ayırt etme yetisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin henüz söylemediği bir şeyi düşünmesi ya da yapmaya niyetlenmesi bağlamında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Düşüncenin içte bulunmasını ve henüz dışa vurulmamasını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onun içinden geçen düşünce ya da niyet

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, dışa vurulmamış düşüncenin yanında niyet, iç bilgi ve ayırt etme yetisini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sözle ortaya konmadan önce zihinde tasarlanan söyleyiş içeriğine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin zihninde bulunan fakat henüz sözle açıklanmamış içeriği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal içsel idrakin daha geniş alanıdır; komşu dal özellikle dile getirilmeden önce zihinde tasarlanan söze yönelir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; söylenmemiş düşünce komşusu, içsel alanın söz tasarısından daha geniş olduğunu en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.branch_image_ar: ما في النفس من عقل وروع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما في نفس المرء من روع وقصد، ونفس العقل والتمييز، وما يعبر عنه بالغيب أو العندية في سياق ما في النفس.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الذات المؤكدة ولا الروح التي بها الحياة إلا إذا دل السياق على الإدراك الباطن.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نفس العقل التي يكون بها التمييز وفي نفس فلان أن يفعل أي في روعه وتعلم ما في نفسي أي ما عندي أو غيبك (tahdhib); يعلم ما في أنفسكم وتعلم ما في نفسي ولا أعلم ما في نفسك (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir yanda karakter, dayanıklılık ve cömertliği; öte yanda büyüklük duygusu, gurur, onur, yüksek amaç ve kendine saygıyı aktarır. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu iki görünüm tek ve ayrışmaz bir huy gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Karakter gücü ile yüksek özdeğer aynı dalda iki bağlı görünüm olarak ayrılır; dışarıdaki değerli mal ve onun için yarışma kapsama girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişiyle kurulan kalıp karakter, dayanıklılık ve cömertliği; çıplak biçim büyüklük, onur ve yüksek amacı bildirir.

concept_map.definition: Kişide görülen sağlam karakter, dayanıklılık ve cömertliktir; buna bağlı ikinci görünüm, kişinin kendi değerini yüksek tutması, onur, yüksek amaç ve kimi bağlamlarda gurur göstermesidir.

facets.statement: Kişinin sağlam karakterli, dayanıklı ve cömert oluşunu bildirir.
Kişinin büyüklük duygusu, gururu, onuru, yüksek amacı ve kendine saygısı da ayrı görünüm olarak aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kaydı, sağlam ve cömert karakter görünümünü kişinin büyüklük, onur, yüksek amaç ve kendine saygı duygularıyla yan yana getirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin dayanıklılığı, cömertliği ve kendine verdiği yüksek değer birlikte anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Karakter gücünü, cömertliği, onuru ve yüksek özdeğeri birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin kendi değerini koruması, yüksek hedef taşıması veya gurur göstermesi bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Onuru, yüksek amacı ve kendine değer verme yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, iyilik yapmaya hevesle yönelme, canlılık ve gönül genişliği üzerinde durur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, cömert ve iyi davranışa yatkın kişi görünümünde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kişinin yerleşik karakter gücü ve özdeğerini anlatır; komşu ise iyilik yapma anındaki gönüllü canlılık ve atılganlığı öne çıkarır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى الخلق والجلادة والسخاء، وبمعنى العظمة والكبر والعزة والهمة والأنفة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو النفيس من المال ولا المنافسة على شيء خارج النفس.
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل له نفس أي خلق وجلادة وسخاء (ayn); النفس العظمة والكبر والعزة والهمة والأنفة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mekânsal uzaklık ve genişliği, işte hareket alanı ve süre payını, ayrıca uzunluk ve zaman uzatımını aynı genişleme ölçüsü altında açıkça toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ölçülebilir yer, boyut veya süre genişliğidir; belirli bir sıkıntıyı giderme ya da sabahın açılması değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kalıp kullanım bir işteki hareket alanını, biçimler ise süre payı ile mekânsal ya da boyutsal genişliği anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Yer bakımından uzaklık veya aralık, boyut bakımından uzunluk ve genişlik, zaman ya da iş bakımından ise ek süre ve hareket alanıdır. Bütün kullanımlarda sınırlar arasındaki payın büyümesi esastır.

facets.statement: Mekânda iki sınır arasındaki uzaklık, açıklık veya boyutsal genişliktir.
Zamanda ek süre, işte ise rahat davranmaya elveren hareket alanıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar uzaklık, açıklık, uzunluk, ek süre ve işte hareket alanını sınırlar arasındaki payın genişlemesi altında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Mekânsal aralık, nesne boyutu, ek süre veya bir işteki hareket alanı anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Mekânı, boyutu, süreyi ve hareket alanını ortak genişleme ölçüsüyle korur.

contextual_glosses.text: rahat hareket edecek alan ve süre
contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işi yapmak için yeterli serbestlik ve ek zaman bulunduğu bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşteki serbestliği ve ek süre payını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, uzun insanı, uçsuz bucaksız yeri ve uzun süren işleri özel kullanımlar olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal mekânsal uzaklık, uzunluk ve bir işin sürmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genişleyen payı yer, boyut ve süre arasında geneller; komşu dal belirli varlıkların uzun veya uzak oluşuna ve işin uzamasına yönelir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; uzunluk ve uzaklık ortaklığının yanında odaktaki süre ve hareket alanı ekini gösteren komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السعة في الأمر، والفسحة، والمهلة، وطول الأجل أو النهار أو الكتاب، وبعد المنزل واتساع ما بين الفريقين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو تفريج الكربة المخصوص ولا تنفس الصبح من حيث الانفلاق إلا إن كان المراد مطلق الامتداد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: هذا المكان أنفس من ذاك أي أبعد شيئا (ayn); أنت في نفس من أمرك أي في سعة ولك في هذا الأمر نفسة أي مهلة (sihah); هذا المنزل أنفس أي أبعد وكتبت كتابا نفسا أي طويلا وزد في أجلي نفسا وبين الفريقين نفس أي متسع (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın bildirimi, belirli bahis okunun beşinci sırada olduğu ve beş pay taşıdığı yönündedir. Aynı toplu iddiada dördüncü sıra biçiminde bir aktarım da bulunduğu için sıra tartışmasız gösterilemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Adlandırma eski bahis oyunundaki belirli oka aittir; temel sıra beşinci, kayıtlı karşı görüş dördüncüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim yalnızca eski bahis oyunundaki belirli pay okunu adlandırır; kişi ya da değer yarışması anlamı taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Eski bir bahis oyununda kullanılan, çoğunluk aktarımına göre beşinci sıradaki ve beş pay taşıyan oktur. Başka bir aktarım onu dördüncü sıraya koyar.

facets.statement: Eski bahis oyunundaki beşinci pay oku olarak ve beş payla tanımlanır.
Aynı toplu kaynak kaydında okun dördüncü sırada olduğu yönünde karşı bir aktarım bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kaydı belirli oyun okunu çoğunlukla beşinci sıra ve beş payla tanımlar; bunun yanında dördüncü sıra aktarımını da korur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli oyun okunun baskın aktarımdaki sırası ve pay değeri kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Oyun alanını, belirli oku, beşinci sırayı ve beş payı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, henüz uç ve tüy takılmamış ok gövdesini ve oyun oklarının herhangi birini genel olarak kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sıra ve pay değeriyle belirlenen özel oktur; komşu dal ise herhangi bir oyun okunu veya işlenmemiş ok gövdesini anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النافس اسما لقدح من قداح الميسر، خاصة الخامس على نص أكثر المصادر، مع التنبيه إلى قول الرابع في Sihah.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو العائن ولا المتنافس في القيمة.

root_profile.summary: Kök, soluk alıp vermeden sıkıntı giderme, kan, doğum, içim payı, su, açılma-genişleme, değer yarışı, canlılık, özdeşlik, iç düşünce, karakter ve eski oyun okuna uzanan çok dallı bir anlam ağı kurar.
